disclaimer: Storm severity and access settings are simulated operational overlays. They adjust illustrative work scope (quantity) and when crews may begin work. They do not change AEP workbook direct person-hours or the 4.5 indirect labor multiplier.

minor.label: Minor
minor.description: Single-unit replacement scope per damaged component (baseline illustrative storm).

moderate.label: Moderate
moderate.description: Expanded scope: additional spans, hardware, or assembly work on the same component (quantity only).

major.label: Major
major.description: Heavy storm damage scope: multiple spans/units counted against the same AEP CU averages (quantity only).

normal.label: Normal
normal.description: Roads open; crews begin when available.

difficult.label: Difficult
difficult.description: Debris, flooding, or limited access delays safe work start (not added to AEP install/removal hours).

restricted.label: Restricted
restricted.description: Blocked routes or unsafe conditions; extended mobilization and per-site access waits.

mobilization_override_note: Optional extra mobilization hours add to crew_mobilization_hours (simulated staging delay).
